name: avatar
summary: A person's or a thing's picture, or their initials on a colour that is theirs.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Who or what it is: its spoken name, and where the initials and the colour come from.

properties.name: src
properties.description: The picture's address. Until it loads, or if it fails, the initials show.

properties.name: alt
properties.description: What is spoken instead of the name; empty when the name is written beside it.

properties.name: initials
properties.description: Letters to draw instead of the ones taken from the name.

properties.name: shape
properties.description: circle for a person, square for a team or an app, agent for an AI agent.

properties.name: color
properties.description: colorful picks one of eight hues from the name, the same on every platform; brand is the primary; neutral the secondary surface.

properties.name: idForColor
properties.description: What colorful picks the hue from instead of the name: a stable id.

properties.name: presence
properties.description: A dot with its own glyph and tone. A square has none.

properties.name: presenceLabel
properties.description: What the dot says, spoken after the name.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: A symbol in place of the initials.

states.name: rest
states.description: The picture, or the initials on the hue. A null name shimmers in the avatar's shape and says that it is loading.

accessibility.name: Its name (or alt), then its presence's words: "Ana Lind, Busy". The initials are drawn, not read.
accessibility.web: A <span role="img"> named by its name; the initials are CSS generated content.
accessibility.apple: One element with the image trait, named by its name and presence; hidden when alt is empty and there is no presence.
accessibility.windows: UI Automation ControlType.Image named by its name and presence.

cases.person: A circle with AL on Ana's hue.
A circle with AL and a red dot at its lower end corner.

deviations: Sizes are named 2xl and 3xl on web; xxl and xxxl elsewhere, since a native identifier can't start with a digit.
Presence values are do-not-disturb and out-of-office on web.
The presence values are doNotDisturb and outOfOffice. The dot sits on a ring of the page's colour rather than web's cut-out.
